result.notes: Previous pass produced zero rows (no search budget); this pass ran all 28 allowed searches and wrote 45 rows. Strongest JLL series captured: Q3 2023 (vacancy 4.0%, +120 bps, 8.1M SF deliveries, 6.4M SF leasing, $16.60/SF asking rent, North NJ -3.2M SF YTD absorption vs Central/South +3.5M SF, 1.8M SF starts), Q2/H1 2025 (10.6M SF Q2 leasing, 18.7M SF H1, five 400K+ Class A deals totaling 3.1M SF, vacancy +20 bps, asking rents 4.3% off peak), Q3 2025 (vacancy 7.6%, 10.7M SF leasing, 100K+ higher-end deals 44% of volume), Q4/FY2025 (Class A vacancy 6.5%, leasing >43M SF, construction lowest since 2019). Rows flagged YEAR_INFERRED in notes need verification before use: the re-nj 'Exit 8A top 10 leases' article (vacancy 4%, 6.9M SF Q2 leasing, 1.7M SF absorption, Exit 8A 54.9% share) whose year I inferred as 2020 from the Amazon/Lollytogs/Mark Fisher leases cited; the Bisnow David Knee article (approx 2019); the Moonachie IOS $7M/acre data point (2025). 2026 data (JLL Q1 2026: 13.1M SF leasing, vacancy 6.3%, Class A 11.6%, Class B/C 4.1%) was deliberately excluded per the 2019-2025 rule. Leads for sibling workstreams found incidentally and NOT written here: CommercialEdge NJ sales volume/$-per-SF 2024 (commercialsearch.com, roi-nj 2025-04-30) for D6; Avison Young NJ cold-storage 0.3% vacancy (re-nj.com) for D5; NAI DiLeo-Bram / NAI Hanson 2023-2024 pricing ($239/SF H2 2023 vs $265 H1 2023, $180-190/SF early 2024, mid-5% cap rates Q1 2024, Harrison/Kearny 49-acre IOS portfolio $156.3M, South Plainfield 9-acre IOS $33.25M) for D4/A6; CBRE 2020-2022 NJ figures for D2. Best remaining JLL sources to try if budget is granted later: re-nj.com and roi-nj.com per-quarter JLL coverage for 2021-2022 and 2024 (titles seen but excerpts gave only CBRE numbers), and JLL's content/dam PDF URLs for 'new-jersey-industrial-market-dynamics' by quarter.
